doc.brief: The QGraphicsSceneContextMenuEvent class provides context menu events in the graphics view framework.
doc.index_brief: Context menu events in the graphics view framework

QGraphicsSceneContextMenuEvent::Reason r.brief: Returns the reason for the context menu event.

QPoint screenPos() const.brief: Returns the position of the mouse cursor in screen coordinates at the moment the context menu was requested.

QPointF pos() const.brief: Returns the position of the mouse cursor in item coordinates at the moment the context menu was requested.

QPointF scenePos() const.brief: Returns the position of the mouse cursor in scene coordinates at the moment the context menu was requested.

Qt::KeyboardModifiers modifiers() const.brief: Returns the keyboard modifiers in use when the context menu was requested.
